name: Nothing Can Stop Me
source: Jeff and his two cousins Megan and Karen live with their aunt and uncle. It’s the beginning of the holidays and his PC is down. It’s shit when you like geek. It takes money to fix it. Money doesn’t come from the sky, you have to get it. Don’t have any remorse, no pity, only the money counts.
translation: 杰夫和两个表姐妹梅根、凯伦一起住在姨父姨妈家里。假期刚刚开始，他的电脑却偏偏罢工了。对一个宅男极客来说，这简直糟透了。修电脑需要钱，而钱不会从天上掉下来，只能靠自己去弄到手。抛开一切悔恨与怜悯吧，唯独金钱才是一切。
